purpose: Connect a real Song problem to the evidence N0TE can actually verify, keep observations separate from inferences, and present two materially different bounded intervention paths without pretending that N0TE heard, changed or approved the Song.

lineage.outcome: The artist can state a real Song problem and receive an evidence-bounded diagnosis that says what N0TE observed, what it is only inferring, and two distinct ways to test the problem while preserving explicit locks such as an unchanged vocal melody.
lineage.capability: Evidence-grounded creative diagnosis and intervention branching

why_now: The current Song surface already proves identity, Session objective, managed material, exact local signal evidence, bounded suggestions, audition, Learning decisions and relaunch continuity. The earliest missing signature-loop link is the explicit bridge from the artist's stated problem plus verified evidence to a causally humble diagnosis and materially different alternatives.

implementation_contract.input_truth: Artist-entered problem text and current Song/Session context are USER_DECLARED. Exact supported current-Version PCM measurements are OBSERVED. Unsupported or unavailable material remains unavailable.
implementation_contract.diagnosis_truth: Diagnosis statements are bounded hypotheses, never observations and never claims that N0TE subjectively heard the Song.
implementation_contract.alternatives: Return two materially different intervention paths with distinct creative dimensions; explicit locks constrain both paths.
implementation_contract.persistence: Diagnosis is ephemeral and read-only. Rendering or preparing it creates no Song artifact, preference, taste memory, Learning outcome or action authority.
implementation_contract.mutation: No DAW, provider, file, Song Version or audio bytes are changed by this increment.

completion_proof: normal Song consumer path accepts a bounded problem statement
verified current-Version PCM evidence is surfaced as observation without private IDs or paths
unsupported or corrupted evidence produces no invented substitute metrics
inference is explicitly labeled and cannot masquerade as observation
two intervention paths are materially distinct and honor locked dimensions
no diagnosis result persists as canonical Song state merely by rendering
Song/session changes invalidate the prepared diagnosis
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass at exact head
